Currently sql4ml supports the translation of SQL create view queries of the following form,

    CREATE VIEW $(name) AS
    SELECT $(columns), $(numericExpr)
    FROM $(tables)
    WHERE $(joinElement)
    GROUP BY $(groupingElement)
